name: Kaguyahime
source:
Initial Class: Sniper

A girl who is always holed up in her room, who won’t fight unless her demands are satisfied. She is extremely lazy, and rides a big vehicle called "Bamboo No. 1" both when she moves and fights, rarely moving her body on her own.

When she first met [url=/c57596]Jack[/url], she thought of him as a convenient errand boy who will go out to get the things she wants, but as they overcome all sorts of difficulties together, her heart will gradually open up to him. She may or may not have the ability to release the “Truant Seven Tools” from the hem of her skirt…
